name: technical-grid
title: Animated Technical Grid
description: Hairline blueprint grid with a scan line and pulsing nodes.

props.description: Paints the grid behind its children.

props.name: fade
props.description: Fades the grid toward an edge.

props.name: cellSize
props.description: Minor cell size in px, 8 to 160.

props.name: animated
props.description: Turns the scan and pulses off.

variants.name: tone
variants.description: Line ink: muted, strong or clay.

accessibility: Decorative layers are aria-hidden and ignore pointer events.
Reduced motion hides the scan and pulses.
